## CI infrastructure gap: measured postmerge source repair

**Gap:** `CI-DOCKER-IMAGE-PULLS-BLOCK-LIVE-TESTS-01` → **fixed (not verified)** in `sahool-brain/gaps/registry.md`.

**Why this is a follow-up PR, not a new runtime fix:** The executable fix and red/green mirror/tamper witnesses landed already in #1193 (`e924bba2`). The gap was deliberately left open for *postmerge* proof. This PR binds actual postmerge GitHub Actions receipts to its registry transition; it does not duplicate the implementation or change CI configuration.

### Bounded measured acceptance evidence

- PR #1193 GHCR-only live mirror validation: **five of five original OCI indexes** pulled by digest with `CI_IMAGE_SOURCE=GHCR_VERIFIED_INDEX` mandatory and no fallback accepted: [live proof](https://github.com/kafaat/ai_platform_complete_v2.0.0_enhanced/actions/runs/38731771468/job/116412151761).
- **First postmerge main `e924bba2`:** [Integration Tests](https://github.com/kafaat/ai_platform_complete_v2.0.0_enhanced/actions/runs/38744260158/job/116453631363), [Notification real PostgreSQL](https://github.com/kafaat/ai_platform_complete_v2.0.0_enhanced/actions/runs/38744260528/job/116453632508) and [Frontend nginx harness](https://github.com/kafaat/ai_platform_complete_v2.0.0_enhanced/actions/runs/38744260158/job/116453631388) each succeeded, with GHCR_VERIFIED_INDEX in their logs.
- **Second postmerge main `5c9f6bf0`:** [Integration Tests](https://github.com/kafaat/ai_platform_complete_v2.0.0_enhanced/actions/runs/38752463588/job/116482112274), [Notification PostgreSQL](https://github.com/kafaat/ai_platform_complete_v2.0.0_enhanced/actions/runs/38752462883/job/116482106503), [Frontend nginx](https://github.com/kafaat/ai_platform_complete_v2.0.0_enhanced/actions/runs/38752463588/job/116482112096), and [Decision 033 PG16 proof](https://github.com/kafaat/ai_platform_complete_v2.0.0_enhanced/actions/runs/38752463588/job/116482112540) all passed. Integration logged GHCR PostgreSQL and Redis; notification and frontend logged GHCR PostgreSQL and nginx.
- JSONL machine-readable source references and bounded claims are in `certification/evidence/ci_ghcr_postmerge_20261015/postmerge_ci_image_proof.jsonl`.

**Limits:** This demonstrates two successful postmerge CI rounds without ECR 429 in the measured jobs. It does **not** certify permanent registry reliability, every workflow, any Railway deployment, or production-readiness. `verified` remains unclaimed.

**Merge guard:** branch starts from exact `main@5c9f6bf0`, modifies the single canonical gap row and adds one independent evidence receipt. No `shared/security/`, TTS, RAG, `frontend/nginx.conf`, or workflow changes. Run `brain_duplicate_gap_identity_guard.py`, brain state-transition, generated/release checks and actual-head CI before considering merge; update generated artifacts if CI reports drift.

Capability-Impact: IRR-003, IRR-009
